name: Seismic Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.

stats: Exerts the next 6 Melee Slam Attacks you perform
Buff grants 5% more Armour per 5 Power, counting a maximum of 25 Power
Buff grants 15% increased Stun Threshold per 5 Power, counting a maximum of 25 Power
Exerted Attacks have 50% more Area of Effect
Knocks back and Interrupts Enemies in a smaller Area
Counts total Power of Enemies in Range
200% increased Knockback Distance
Base duration is 2.50 seconds
